summary: The agent wrote a plan, then ran a venv replication with downloaded MUSE vectors. It reproduced the ES MWEAT, the FR value (with dedup explained), 0.389 with the PCA bug and SVC, the classifier accuracies, Spearman, and the translation Original column at 200k. It also showed that 50k candidates give the Shift column. Table 1 and 2 mitigated columns were honestly marked blocked. It surfaced several [R] items (SVC vs LDA, PCA bug, the FR 8-pair list, missing code, missing embeddings, no French similarity source). It missed the High validity items and the word-pair cue issue, and it treated the 'printed formula' as contradicting the table statistic. Reporting was honest and well calibrated.
